Graffiti Outside EA’s Madrid Office Fuels “Save Mass Effect” Campaign

03 Nov 2026, 12:28 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysA Reddit user identified as Ok_Link9625 posted photos showing the phrase “Save Mass Effect” spray‑painted on the ground and a wall at Electronic Arts’ (EA) office complex in Madrid, Spain. The images were taken as the user was leaving a nearby cinema and were shared on the r/MassEffect subreddit.

What happened?

A Reddit user identified as Ok_Link9625 posted photos showing the phrase “Save Mass Effect” spray‑painted on the ground and a wall at Electronic Arts’ (EA) office complex in Madrid, Spain. The images were taken as the user was leaving a nearby cinema and were shared on the r/MassEffect subreddit.

Context of the protest

  • BioWare shutdown – Earlier this month EA announced that it was closing BioWare’s Madrid studio and putting the *Mass Effect* franchise on indefinite hold. The decision also cancelled the planned *Mass Effect: Universe* project and halted development of *Mass Effect 5*.
  • #SaveMassEffect movement – The hashtag quickly turned into a coordinated fan campaign. A petition demanding that EA revive the series amassed roughly 290,000 signatures at the time of reporting.
  • Public actions – Fans have taken the cause to the streets, including a billboard in Times Square on October 26 and plans for another display outside this year’s Game Awards.

Community reaction to the graffiti

  • Some supporters praised the act, with one commenter writing “Hell yeah.”
  • Others questioned its effectiveness, noting that “tagging office buildings may not make EA think the IP is worth saving.”
  • *Mass Effect* composer John Gavins (quoted on social media) remarked that “the fans are serious as a heart attack,” acknowledging the rapid escalation of the campaign.

Official stance

EA has not commented on the graffiti. In a statement to Bloomberg, the publisher confirmed that it has re‑prioritized resources toward *Star Wars Battlefront 3*, effectively shelving *Mass Effect 5*.

How to verify the claim

  1. Check the Reddit post – The original images are still visible on r/MassEffect (search for the user “Ok_Link9625”).
  2. Look for Bloomberg coverage – Bloomberg reported the shift in EA’s development focus and the cancellation of the *Mass Effect* sequel.
  3. Follow the petition – The Save Mass Effect petition is hosted on Change.org; the signature count is publicly displayed.

Practical implications for fans

  • Consumer pressure – The graffiti adds a visible, local element to a largely online movement, potentially drawing media attention.
  • Risk of vandalism – While the act signals frustration, it also raises legal and ethical concerns; EA has not encouraged such tactics.
  • Future advocacy – Organizers plan more billboards and digital campaigns, suggesting the graffiti is part of a broader, multi‑channel strategy rather than a standalone solution.
